english.title: Use a prohibited unit of measurement for trade
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used for trade a unit of measurement, namely **(..SPECIFY THE UNIT OF MEASUREMENT..), which was not included in Parts I to V of Schedule 1 to the Weights and Measures Act 1985
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 8(1)(a) and (4) and 84(1) and (2) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes:
(i) Section 83(1) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides that in England and Wales, proceedings for any offence under this Act or any instrument made under this Act. shall not be instituted except by or on behalf of a local weights and measures authority or the chief officer of police for a police area.
(ii) Section 8(4) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides that any measure or weight used, or in any person's possession for use shall be liable to be forfeited.
